title_patterns.abnormal: (股票|股价|证券).*异常波动|股票异常波动
title_patterns.risk_warning: 股票交易风险提示|股票交易风险.{0,3}提示|股票交易.*风险提示|股票交易风险的提示|股票交易风险提示性
title_patterns.reduction_plan: 减持.*(?:计划|预披露)|减持股份预披露
title_patterns.enforcement: 立案调查|立案告知|行政处罚|监管警示|纪律处分|监管函|警示函
title_patterns.earnings_negative_title: 预亏|预减|亏损|业绩下滑
title_patterns.earnings_forecast: 业绩预告|业绩预盈|业绩预亏|业绩预增|业绩预减

title_patterns.positive_catalyst: 中标|重大合同|增持计划|回购股份方案|业绩预增|业绩预盈

body_patterns.valuation_warning: (?:市盈率|市净率|估值)[^。；]{0,100}(?:远高于|明显高于|显著高于|高于行业|高于同行|较高|过高|偏高)
body_patterns.deal_uncertainty: (?:交易|重组|收购)[^。；]{0,100}(?:不确定性|无法纳入|尚未完成)

body_scope: uniform retrieved risk warnings / reduction plans / enforcement / earnings forecasts; excludes case-only extra documents

rules.explicit_warning_5: D1-known risk warning publication days >=1 in D0 plus prior5 sessions
rules.repeated_warning_5: D1-known risk warning publication days >=2 in same window
rules.specific_adverse_5: D1-known reduction plan (not completed/terminated) or enforcement or explicit earnings-negative title
rules.valuation_warning_5: D1-known valuation-warning wording in uniform document set
rules.theme_denial_5: D1-known explicit theme-denial wording in uniform document set
rules.media_adverse_5: D1-known non-price-only media headline adverse mention; only complete public search retrievals
